source.providerSemanticsGate: Portal's templateDeployV2 source.branch must be release-marketplace-v0.1.12; source.commitSha is not relied on because the provider ignores it. The repository ruleset for the fixed release branch must remain active before deployment.

branchImmutability.verification: The exact GitHub ruleset ID, URL, enforcement, and resolved tag/branch SHA are recorded in the successor receipt after publication.

sourceBuild.startCommandPolicy: Keep the tracked image entrypoint; never launch program/src/index.ts directly.

verification.runtimeSourceIdentity: Record the Railway-resolved commit and deployment ID; Railway health alone is not source or acceptance proof.

ownership.bootstrap: entrypoint.mjs verifies /data without following symlinks, prepares only /data/state and /data/logs, then drops to uid/gid 1000

readiness.meaning: Portal identity and scoped Rules credential readiness; not provider execution proof

secretHandling.handoffKey: Generate a unique 32-byte hex or base64url value in the trusted deployment secret store; reuse it across retries, restarts, upgrades and restores; never put it in SQLite backups or the source artifact.

claimsAndScopes.tenantAuthority: MARKETPLACE_ORGANIZATION_ID is the server-bound product tenant; browser workspace, actor and agent labels are not authority.

portalRuntimeLease.verification: ES256 signature against Portal /api/jwks plus live Portal introspection/revocation checks

typedDependencies.failurePolicy: deny or unavailable; no local substitute

providerSetup.scope: Optional, consented provider canary only; no provider account or credential is bundled.
minimumNormallyConsentedSetup: Configure a dedicated or community-scoped Composio GitHub connected account server-side; do not borrow a personal/admin token.
Install and enable github-composio for the bound product tenant and bind connector.observe to github.list.repositories.
Request Portal consent for the exact agent, deployment, connected account and account:<connected_account_id> resource.
Execute only the published repository-list action and record the provider response, Marketplace audit event and Portal consent/lease identifiers.
Revoke or expire the Portal consent and verify the same action is denied after revocation.

migrationAndRecovery.database: SQLite at /data/state/marketplace.sqlite; WAL and foreign keys are enabled; migrations are owned by program/src/store.ts.
migrationBehavior: Create missing Marketplace tables and indexes on startup.
Add runtime_sources_json idempotently when upgrading older Marketplace databases.
Decrypt and validate existing Portal handoff rows before any legacy plaintext re-encryption transaction.
Missing or wrong MARKETPLACE_HANDOFF_ENCRYPTION_KEY fails startup without rewriting the restored database.
migrationAndRecovery.backup: Use a consistent SQLite backup after graceful stop or an approved online-backup procedure; back up provider settings and secrets separately with protected modes; never include the handoff key.
migrationAndRecovery.restore: Restore database/settings/secrets into an isolated service, inject the exact same handoff key before startup, then run health, protected auth, tenant isolation, Rules, Portal and idempotency checks before cutover.
migrationAndRecovery.rollback: Rollback only to a pinned Marketplace source/image revision after schema and encrypted-row compatibility is checked; preserve the same handoff key and restore backup together when compatibility is uncertain.
migrationAndRecovery.keyRotation: Not a retry/restart/rollback operation; perform only as an explicit migration with a tested re-encryption and recovery plan.

requiredPortalEvidence: Railway-resolved source commit equals the pinned source commit.
Railway templateDeployV2 uses branch release-marketplace-v0.1.12 and does not silently fall back to main or rely on ignored source.commitSha.
The v0.1.12 repository ruleset remains active with update, non-fast-forward and deletion restrictions and no bypass actor.
Customer project builds the public source without GHCR or private registry credentials.
Persistent volume ownership/bootstrap, health, protected readiness and exact source identity are recorded.
Portal-owned deployment binding and consented provider read-canary are separately accepted.

limitations: This manifest does not create or publish a Railway template.
GHCR is optional and is not an onboarding or source-build dependency.
A public source build, health response or synthetic smoke does not prove Portal deployment, provider authorization, end-to-end execution or human UAT.
Nango, Activepieces and MCP remain declared adapter boundaries; this recipe does not add or broaden those providers.
